## Docs behind their code

In place: 18 docs map to code of their own, and 10 of them keep pace with that code.

[![Docs behind their code](./doc-drift.svg)](./doc-drift.svg)

The longest bars are the docs whose code has moved most since the doc last changed, so they are the first to read again before an agent leans on them. 2 docs measured against the whole repository are counted here, not drawn.

## Review on recent merges

In place: 3 of 10 sampled merged changes approved and 2 more reviewed, and 1 not known.

[![Review on recent merges](./review-strip.svg)](./review-strip.svg)

Each tick is one merged change, oldest first, so a run of ticks merged without review shows a stretch that a single share hides; a dot marks review-bot output.
